God's promise to drive out the Amorites and other peoples from the land
The call to fear the Lord and serve Him alone, which the people affirm in Joshua 24:18
The Lord's promise to drive out the nations from the land ahead of Israel
Earlier verses in the same chapter describing how the Lord gave the Amorites into Israel's hand
Joshua's challenge to the people to choose whom they will serve, which the people answer in verse 18
A reminder of how the Lord delivered Israel from Egypt and from all who oppressed them
The basis for the confession 'He is our God' - the Lord who brought Israel out of Egypt
The confession that the Lord is God and that we belong to Him
The people's confession on Carmel: 'The Lord, He is God' - the same type of worship response
